pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū udake uccāram pi passāvam pi kheḷam pi karonti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā udake uccāram pi passāvam pi kheḷam pi karissanti seyyathāpi gihikāmabhogino 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū udake . . . karissantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.8: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave udake . . . karothā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.11: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā udake . . . karissatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.12: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.13: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.14.1: na udake uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā karissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.15: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānā bhikkhū udake uccāram pi passāvam pi kheḷam pi kātuṃ kukkuccāyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.3: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā udake uccāram pi passāvam pi kheḷam pi kātuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.5: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.6.1: na udake agilāno uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā karissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.7: na udake agilānena uccāro vā passāvo vā kheḷo vā kātabbo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.8: yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca udake agilāno uccāraṃ vā . . . karoti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.29: parisuddh' etthāyasmanto, tasmā tuṇhī. evam etaṃ dhārayāmīti.
